risks.title: Illicit tobacco trade competition
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranked first in Item 3.D, with very strong language ("significant and growing threat", "adverse effect"), upward trend due to taxation/inflation/weak enforcement, major weight for the tobacco industry with multiple impacts (volumes, brands, costs, regulation).

risks.title: Geopolitical tensions disrupting operations
risks.score_rationale: Major risk in Item 3.D with high-intensity language ("unpredictable", "outside of its control"), upward trend (Red Sea conflicts mentioned, climate change amplifying), direct impact on supply chain and market access.

risks.title: Safety of employees and third parties in the workplace
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 3.D with strong language ("utmost importance", "serious injuries"), stable but persistent trend, impact on reputation, civil/criminal liability, and sustainability credibility.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and disruptions to IT systems
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk in Item 3.D with alert language ("continuously under attack", "intensify", "AI-powered tools"), upward trend (growing external threats, AI adoption), potential major impact on operations and sensitive data.

risks.title: Inability to meet demand in New Categories
risks.score_rationale: Strategic risk in Item 3.D with language of importance ("complex environment", "enhanced risk"), upward trend (Vuse PMTA rejections, menthol bans in California), direct impact on growth and risk reduction goals.

risks.title: Failure of critical financial counterparties
risks.score_rationale: Identified risk in Item 3.D but less operational in nature than others, moderate language ("may not be recovered"), stable trend, limited impact on cash and risk hedging.

risks.title: Volatility in raw material prices and costs
risks.score_rationale: Major operational risk in Item 3.D with impact-focused language ("price volatility", "numerous factors"), upward trend (inflation, tariffs, trade embargoes), significant weight for manufacturing cost structure.

risks.title: Regulatory risks and product restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Major cross-cutting risk mentioned in forward-looking statements and Item 3.D ("adverse domestic or international legislation", "regulatory restrictions"), upward trend (plain packaging, graphic warnings, flavor bans), existential impact on business model.
